search-history-command.name: Search history
search-history-command.description: Stores search history in data/history.json with timestamps; !history shows a paginated, deletable list.

maxEntries.label: Max entries
maxEntries.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep (oldest removed when exceeded).

gateBehindAuth.label: Gate behind auth
gateBehindAuth.description: Only people signed in to Settings can read, add to or delete the history. Everyone else's searches are not recorded.
